DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 両替のご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change some money?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一万円札を一枚持っています。手伝ってくれた五人へ同じ額ずつ渡したいので、小さい額の紙幣へ替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一万円を五人への同額謝礼用に両替したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one ten-thousand-yen note. I'd like smaller notes so I can give equal amounts to five people who helped me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change ten thousand yen for equal thank-you payments to five people.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お一人へ渡す額は、おいくらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much will you give each person?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二千円ずつです。二千円札五枚ではなく、千円札を二枚ずつにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人二千円を千円二枚で渡す希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two thousand yen each. I'd like two 1,000-yen notes per person, not five two-thousand-yen notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that each person should get two thousand yen as two 1,000-yen notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 千円札十枚のご希望ですね。お取扱いと費用を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you'd like ten 1,000-yen notes. I'll check our handling arrangements and charges and explain them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その枚数です。費用がある場合は、一万円から引くのか別に払うのかも先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千円十枚と費用の払い方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's the right number. If there's a fee, I'd also like to know beforehand whether it's deducted from the ten thousand yen or paid separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm ten 1,000-yen notes and ask how to pay any fee in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでは別にお支払いいただく形です。本日の取扱いの案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, it's paid separately. Please look at today's service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内を確認しました。用意した別の小銭で費用を払い、渡す一万円分は減らさない形でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 費用を別に払い謝礼元本一万円を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked it. Please let me pay the charge with the separate coins I prepared, without reducing the ten thousand yen I'm giving out.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay the charge separately in Japanese and keep the ten-thousand-yen thank-you fund intact.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 千円札十枚をご確認ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十枚あります。ここで五人分に分けて通路をふさがず、家に帰って二枚ずつ封筒へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十枚を数え自宅で五人分へ分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are ten. Rather than block the passage dividing them into five shares here, I'll put two notes in each envelope when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Count ten notes in Japanese and say you'll divide them into five shares at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-UJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Have a safe journey home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお守りを二体、ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like two of these protective charms?

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。姉と祖母へ一体ずつ渡すので、別々に包んでいただきたいです。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉と祖母へ渡す二体を個別に包装してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One is for my older sister and one for my grandmother, so I'd like them wrapped separately.
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for separate wrapping for two charms, one for your older sister and one for your grandmother.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二体とも同じ色をお選びですが、包みを区別する必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-03.translation: You've chosen the same color for both. Do you need to distinguish the packages?

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 必要です。姉には青い袋、祖母には白い袋で渡したいです。中のお守りの色は同じで構いません。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身は同色のまま外袋だけ二色にしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'd like a blue bag for my sister and a white one for my grandmother. The charms inside can stay the same color.
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the contents can remain the same color and only the outer bags should have different colors.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の色は白だけです。包みの外に、小さな目印の紙を添えることはできます。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-05.translation: We only have white bags. We can attach a small marking slip outside the wrapping.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、片方にだけ目印を付けてください。目印があるほうを姉へ渡します。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白袋しかないため姉の包みにだけ目印を付ける案を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please mark just one of them. I'll give the marked one to my sister.
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since only white bags are available, choose in Japanese to mark only your sister's package.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。お守りそのものに名前を書くということではありませんね。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You don't mean writing a name on the charm itself, correct?

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、名前は書かなくて大丈夫です。包みを受け取ったら、自分のメモで相手を記録します。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前の記入は不要で渡す相手は自分のメモへ記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. There's no need to write names. After receiving the packages, I'll record who each is for in my own notes.
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that names needn't be written and you'll note the recipients yourself.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが目印付きです。もう一方には紙を付けていません。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the marked one. I haven't attached a slip to the other.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。二つを一緒の袋に入れても、個別の包みは開けずに持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目印付きの包みを確認し個別包装を開けず持ち帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked. Even if I put both in one bag, I'll take them home without opening the individual packages.
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the marked package in Japanese and say you'll keep the individual wrapping closed on the way home.

DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ大切にお持ち帰りください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-MIE-ISE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take good care of them. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘の重さは、持ってみていかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How does the umbrella's weight feel when you hold it?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 軽くて持ちやすいです。ただ、閉じるときに途中で止まりました。私の動かし方が違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試用した傘が途中で止まり動かし方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's light and easy to hold. But it stopped halfway while I was closing it. Am I moving it incorrectly?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the umbrella stopped halfway during your trial and ask about the movement.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは手動式です。持ち手ではなく、軸を滑る部分を動かして閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a manual umbrella. Close it by moving the part that slides along the shaft, not the handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手に何かボタンがあると思って探していました。軸のどこを持って動かすか、見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手にボタンを探していたと説明し軸の操作部分の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was looking for a button on the handle. Could you show me which part of the shaft to hold and move?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were looking for a handle button and request a demonstration of the shaft's moving part.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指を挟まない位置と、留め具を外す部分を店の見本でお見せします。無理に押さず、まず実演をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll use the store sample to show you where to hold it without pinching your fingers and where to release the catch. Don't force it; watch the demonstration first.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の動きを覚えたいので、実演が終わったら見本で一度練習したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演後に見本で閉じる練習をしたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to remember that movement, so after the demonstration, I'd like to practice once on the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to practice closing the sample after the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。ほかのお客様に当たらないこちらの空間でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. Please use this space where you won't hit other customers.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらへ移りました。閉じることができましたが、畳む前にベルトを引っ張る必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定場所で閉じられたと報告しベルトを留める順序を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've moved here. I managed to close it. So I don't need to pull the strap before folding it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report successful closing in the designated space in Japanese and confirm the order of fastening the strap.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベルトは、布をまとめた後に留めます。販売する品はこちらの未使用の一本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Fasten the strap after gathering the fabric. This unused umbrella here is the one for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕組みが分かったので、その一本を買います。見本ではなく、未使用の品を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作を理解し未使用の販売品の購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now that I understand how it works, I'll buy that one. I'll take the unused item rather than the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the operation and choose to buy the unused sale item.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計へどうぞ。それでは、雨の日もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please come to the checkout. Take care on rainy days too.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文は、かけうどんを一杯ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your order is one bowl of plain broth udon, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が少し遅れて来ます。一杯を先に買って、友人が来たら同じ器に麺だけ追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅れて来る友人のため同じ器への麺追加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend is coming a little later. Can I buy one bowl now and add just noodles to the same bowl when my friend arrives?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether noodles can be added to the same bowl for a friend arriving late.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べ始めた器へ追加する注文は受けていません。友人の分は別にご注文ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We don't take orders to add food to a bowl you've begun eating from. Please order your friend's portion separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。私の一杯は今受け取り、友人の分は到着してから新しく注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加不可を受け自分は今受け取り友人は別注文と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll take my bowl now, and my friend will place a new order after arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept that additions aren't possible in Japanese and decide to receive yours now and order separately for your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お席はお決まりですか。二人でご利用なら、奥に空いている二人席があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you chosen a seat? For two people, there's an empty two-person table at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥の二人席にします。友人が注文する間、私の盆を受け渡し台へ戻さなくてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人席を選び食事中の盆を戻す必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll use that table. While my friend orders, is it all right not to return my tray to the serving counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the two-person table in Japanese and ask whether you need to return a tray while still eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食事中のお盆は席に置き、食後に返却口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep your tray at your seat while eating and take it to the return counter afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け渡し台と返却口を混同していました。食べ終えた器は入口側の返却口へ運ぶのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受け渡し台と食後の返却口の違いを言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I confused the serving counter with the return counter. Finished dishes go to the return counter near the entrance, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Restate the difference between the serving counter and after-meal return counter in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。追加注文は友人ご自身で列に並んでいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Your friend should join the queue themselves to order another bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人には、私の器を使わず列で一杯注文するよう連絡します。では、先に席へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ別の一杯を列で注文するよう知らせて席へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend to order one bowl in the queue rather than use my bowl. I'll go to the seat first, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll tell your friend to queue for a separate bowl and go to your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、温かいうちにお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy it while it's hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 三階の客室は、清掃を始められそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you start cleaning the third-floor guest room?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 清掃希望の札は出ていますが、机に開いたノートパソコンがあります。机上の物は動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃希望札と机上の開いたパソコンを報告し未移動と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cleaning-request tag is out, but there's an open laptop on the desk. I haven't moved anything on the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the cleaning-request tag and open laptop in Japanese and say nothing has been moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の私物には触れず、机の清掃は見合わせてください。ほかの場所の状態はどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't touch the guest's belongings, and hold off cleaning the desk. How are the other areas?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 床と洗面台には荷物がありません。ベッドには上着があるので、そこも今は触らないほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 床と洗面台の状態を述べベッドの上着も触らないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's no luggage on the floor or washbasin. There's a jacket on the bed, so should I leave that untouched for now too?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the floor and washbasin in Japanese and ask whether not to touch the jacket on the bed either.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今回は床と洗面台を先に行います。ベッドと机は未実施として記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. This time, do the floor and washbasin first. Record the bed and desk as not done.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 床と洗面台だけ進めます。全部完了の印を付けず、二か所残っていると記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二か所だけ清掃し机とベッドを未実施と記録すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll do only the floor and washbasin. I won't mark everything complete; I'll record that two areas remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll clean only two areas and record the desk and bed as not done.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 清掃の途中にお客様が戻られた場合は、作業を止めて挨拶してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the guest returns during cleaning, stop work and greet them.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻られたら、私物のため机とベッドをまだ清掃していないと説明し、作業継続の希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 客が戻ったら未実施理由を説明し継続希望を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If they return, I'll explain that the desk and bed haven't been cleaned because of their belongings, and ask whether they'd like me to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if the guest returns, you'll explain why areas remain uncleaned and ask whether to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その説明でお願いします。判断に迷ったら、廊下から私に連絡できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain it that way. If you're unsure, you can contact me from the hallway.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 客室内で勝手に荷物の扱いを決めず、必要なら廊下へ出て連絡します。今から指定の範囲に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私物の扱いを独断で決めず廊下から連絡して指定範囲を始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't decide how to handle luggage on my own inside the room. If needed, I'll go into the hallway and contact you. I'll start the designated areas now.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't decide on belongings yourself, will contact staff from the hallway, and begin the designated work.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 了解しました。作業後に記録を見せてください。それでは、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Show me the record after work. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何行きのバスをお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which bus are you waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約は名古屋行きですが、同じ時刻の欄に大阪行きもあります。ここに来た順番で乗ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同時刻に二方面あるため到着順で乗れるか問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My reservation is for Nagoya, but Osaka is listed at the same time too. Can we board in the order we arrived here?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether boarding is by arrival order since two destinations share the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 到着順では決めないでください。予約票の行き先と便名を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't decide by arrival order. I'll check the destination and service number on your reservation slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この予約票の名古屋行き、二号便です。大阪行きの列が先に動いても、そちらへ付いて行かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名古屋二号便の予約を示し大阪の列を追わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This slip says Nagoya, service two. Even if the Osaka queue moves first, I won't follow it.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your Nagoya service-two reservation in Japanese and say you won't follow the Osaka queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二号便の乗車案内が出たら、車体の行き先表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: When boarding is announced for service two, check the destination display on the bus itself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車体に名古屋と出ているか見ます。表示が光って読めない場合は、乗る前に係の方へ便名を言って聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き先表示を読み読めなければ乗車前に便名で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look for Nagoya on the bus. If glare makes it unreadable, I'll tell the staff the service number and ask before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll read the destination and ask staff using the service number before boarding if you can't read it.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。お荷物を預ける予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Will you check any luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい肩掛け鞄だけなので、預ける荷物はありません。人のトランク待ちの列とは分けて並びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 肩掛け鞄のみで荷物を預けないと伝え列の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only have a small shoulder bag, so I won't check anything. I'd like to distinguish this queue from the one for people waiting at the luggage compartment.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only have a shoulder bag and won't check luggage, and ask about the queue difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車券の確認列はこちらです。荷物を預ける人も確認後に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the ticket-check queue. People checking luggage will also be guided after their tickets are checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらの列で二号便の案内を待ちます。鞄を預ける列だと思って横へ移動する必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券確認列で案内を待ちトランク用と思って移動しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here for service-two guidance. So I don't need to move aside thinking this is the luggage-compartment queue, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you'll wait in the ticket-check queue and won't move thinking it's for luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ここでお待ちください。それでは、よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Correct. Please wait here. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの実演で、見えにくい所はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was anything hard to see in the demonstration earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は左利きです。向かい側から見ていたので、手で隠れた部分が分からず、左右も逆に覚えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きで対面実演の手元が隠れ左右を逆に覚えそうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm left-handed. I was facing you, so I couldn't see the parts hidden by your hands, and I'm likely to remember left and right backward.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you're left-handed and the facing demonstration hid hand movements and may reverse your sense of sides.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、同じ向きから見られる席へ移りましょう。まだ材料を編み始めてはいませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's move to a seat where you can watch facing the same direction. You haven't started weaving the material yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ始めていません。分かったふりをして進めず、最初の手元をもう一度見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ編み始めず理解したふりをしないで手元の再実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't started. Rather than pretend I understand and continue, I'd like to see the initial hand movements again.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you haven't begun weaving and request another hand demonstration rather than pretending to understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの席なら、私の手元を横から見られます。左手を使う位置も一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: From this seat, you can see my hands from the side. We'll check where to use your left hand too.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここなら見えます。道具は元の右側の置き場から、自分の左側へ移してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 横から見える席で右の道具を自分の左へ移せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see from here. May I move the tools from their original right-side position to my left?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese from the side-view seat whether you can move the tools on the right to your left.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の材料に当たらない、こちらの台の範囲で配置しましょう。共用の道具は使った後に戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's arrange them within this table's space without hitting other people's materials. Please return shared tools after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の材料だけ左へ寄せます。共用道具は使い終えたら元の置き場へ戻して、次の方が探さなくて済むようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の材料を左へ寄せ共用道具は使用後元の置き場へ戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move only my materials to the left. After using shared tools, I'll return them to their original place so the next person won't have to search.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll move your materials left and return shared tools to their original place after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最初の動きだけ、材料を持つ前にもう一度実演します。分からない所で声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before you hold the material, I'll demonstrate just the first movement again. Please speak up wherever anything is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今度は同じ向きから見ます。右と左を言葉だけで覚えず、自分の手元の位置を確認してから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ向きから実演を見て自分の手元位置を確認後に始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I'll watch facing the same direction. I won't memorize left and right just as words; I'll check my own hand positions before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll watch from the same orientation and check your own hand positions before beginning.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、実演します。それでは、ゆっくり体験をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll demonstrate now, then. Take your time enjoying the experience.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 温めをご希望なのは、こちらのお弁当ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the boxed meal you'd like heated, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、夜勤中に食べます。弁当は職場で精算し、パンは自分用なので、会計を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤弁当は職場精算パンは私用なので別会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I'll eat it on my night shift. Work will reimburse the meal, but the bread is personal, so I'd like separate transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request separate payment in Japanese because the night-shift meal is reimbursed by work and the bread is personal.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先にお弁当だけのお会計をします。飲み物はどちらに入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ring up only the boxed meal first. Which transaction should the drink go on?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飲み物も自分用です。パンと一緒の会計へ入れてください。職場へ出すのは弁当だけのレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲み物は私用会計へ入れ弁当だけのレシートを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The drink is personal too. Please put it with the bread. The receipt I'll submit to work is for the boxed meal only.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the drink belongs on the personal transaction and request a receipt for only the boxed meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。温めたお弁当は、別の袋になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Would you like the heated meal in a separate bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は要りません。この保温鞄へ入れますが、パンは弁当の上に置かず手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋不要と保温鞄の使用を述べパンを重ねないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't need a bag. I'll put it in this insulated bag, but I'll carry the bread by hand rather than put it on top of the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline a bag in Japanese, explain use of your insulated bag, and say you won't stack the bread on the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お弁当のお会計が終わりました。こちらが最初のレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The boxed meal's payment is complete. Here's the first receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらを職場用として財布の左へ入れます。続けてパンと飲み物をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初のレシートを職場用として収納し私用会計を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll put this in the left side of my wallet for work. Please ring up the bread and drink next.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Store the first receipt as the work receipt in Japanese and request the personal transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二回目のお会計です。同じ支払い方法でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's the second transaction. Will you use the same payment method?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二回目は現金にします。職場用のレシートと自分用を重ねず、右側へ分けてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二回目は現金で払いレシートを財布の右へ分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay cash for the second one. I'll keep my personal receipt separately on the right, rather than together with the work receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll pay cash for the second transaction and separate its receipt into your wallet's right side.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚目をお渡しします。それでは、お仕事お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the second receipt. Take care at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙は、この封筒一通をお預かりすればよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this one envelope the letter you'd like us to accept?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。封はしましたが、宛先の建物名を忘れました。封筒を開けないで、表に書き足してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封済み封筒の表へ建物名を追記したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've sealed it, but I forgot the destination building's name. May I add it to the front without opening the envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to add the building name to the front of a sealed envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先が読みやすいよう、住所欄の空いているところへ追記してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please add it in a blank part of the address field so the destination is easy to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地の下に余白があります。そこに建物名と三〇五号室を書きます。元の番地は消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地下の余白へ建物名と三〇五号室を書き元番地を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's space below the street number. I'll write the building name and room 305 there. I won't erase the original street number.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll add the building name and room 305 below the street number while keeping the original number.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場所なら、郵便番号やほかの記載に重なりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That spot won't overlap the postal code or other writing, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人からもらった住所のメモと見比べて、漢字が違わないか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人の住所メモと漢字を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right. I'll compare it with the address note my friend gave me and check that the kanji are correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll compare the kanji with the recipient's address note.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追記が終わったら、お預かりできます。送り主の住所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can accept it once the addition is finished. Is the sender's address there too?

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏に書いてあります。今の住所で、以前住んでいた寮の住所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 裏の差出人住所は以前の寮ではなく現住所と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's on the back. It's my current address, not the dormitory where I used to live.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the sender's address on the back is your current address, not your former dormitory.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、表の追記をもう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the addition on the front once more, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 建物名と三〇五号室まで書けました。宛先と送り主の住所が混ざっていないことも見たので、これをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追記と宛先差出人の区別を確認して差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written the building name and room 305. I've also checked that the recipient's and sender's addresses aren't mixed up, so please accept this.
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the addition and distinction between recipient and sender in Japanese, then submit the letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-MIE-ISE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。それでは、ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: すき焼き用のお肉をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for meat for sukiyaki?

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日の二人分と、明日来る三人の分を買います。一つの大きな包みではなく、日ごとに分けられますか。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日二人分と明日三人分の肉を日別包装にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm buying for two people today and three coming tomorrow. Can you separate it by day rather than make one large package?
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to package meat separately for today's two people and tomorrow's three.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分けられます。量は、お客様が決めた重さでご用意します。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. We'll prepare the weights you decide on.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は二百グラム、明日は三百グラムでお願いします。人数だけで店の方に量を決めてもらうつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で決めた二百グラムと三百グラムを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two hundred grams for today and three hundred for tomorrow, please. I don't mean to have the store decide the amount from just the number of people.
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify your own chosen two hundred and three hundred grams in Japanese.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ部位を二つの包みに分けますか。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shall we put the same cut in two packages?

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、同じ部位にします。片方だけ高い肉へ変えず、二つともこの値札のものをお願いします。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二包とも同じ値札の部位と確認し高級品への変更を断る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the same cut. Please use the meat with this price tag for both, without changing just one to more expensive meat.
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that both packages use the same priced cut and decline an upgrade to expensive meat.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二百グラムの包みに印を付けておきましょうか。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Shall I mark the two-hundred-gram package?

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。印付きが今日の分と分かるよう、帰宅したら容器にも今日と書きます。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日用二百グラムに印を頼み帰宅後も容器を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. When I get home, I'll write “today” on the container too so I know the marked one is for today.
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to mark today's two hundred grams and say you'll distinguish the container at home too.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保冷材をお付けできます。お帰りまでの予定はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can include an ice pack. What are your plans before going home?

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 寄り道をせず帰ります。明日の分の保管方法は包みの表示を読み、不明な点はこちらで聞いてから持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寄り道せず帰り表示で保管方法を確認し不明点を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go home without stopping elsewhere. I'll read the package label about storing tomorrow's portion and ask you about anything unclear before taking it home.
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll go straight home, check the storage label, and ask about unclear points.

DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 保管の案内をお付けします。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-MIE-MATSUSAKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll include storage instructions. Have a safe journey home.
